x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
import math

res = 1e9
p1, p2 = 0, 0

def lca(a, b):
    return a * b // math.gcd(a, b)

if y <= n:
    while math.gcd(x, y) > 1:
        h = math.gcd(x, y)
        x //= h
        y //= h
    print(f"{x}/{y}")
else:
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        h = lca(i, y)
        w = x * (h // y)
        diff1 = abs(w - ((w // (h // i)) * (h // i))) / h
        if res > diff1:
            res = diff1
            p1 = w // (h // i)
            p2 = i
        numerator = w + (h // i) - 1
        denominator = (h // i)
        diff2 = abs(w - ((numerator // denominator) * denominator)) / h
        if res > diff2:
            res = diff2
            p1 = numerator // denominator
            p2 = i
    h = math.gcd(p1, p2)
    p1 //= h
    p2 //= h
    print(f"{p1}/{p2}")
